reason: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year, so paying ₹12,990 for Docketra when my 3 to 5 staff have run fine on spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups for ten years feels unjustified. At 58, I am deeply skeptical of paying double for software unless it proves dead simple and completely effortless on the free pilot first.
objection: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year—why is Docketra more expensive, and will it truly be dead simple for my staff without disrupting our daily WhatsApp routine?
would_change_my_mind: Pricing competitive with Jamku around ₹7,000 a year, or seeing my staff easily handle our 30 client WhatsApp groups on the free pilot with zero learning curve.
